name: Killens Pond State Park Campground

fees.note: Every site has water and electric (50 amp): $23 a night on a winter weekday, $27 in spring and fall, $33 in summer, $38 on a summer Saturday. Non-residents pay 1.25 times the resident price, rounded up. $4 reservation fee. The booking site's prices for 2027 nights, read 2026-10-12 (Delaware's 2026 rate schedule PDF refuses every fetch).
